# Meridian public SDK

Unmodified MIT-licensed headers from https://github.com/heathbrownkeyworks/MeridianUI
at commit `5707877322c85a1bd1c2e3309487f266d0647ca9` (2026-09-13).
Settings.h and the View, RenderLayer, NifView, NifScene public APIs and loaders are vendored with LICENSE-MIT.
The framework runtime is a separate user installation; this package does not redistribute it.
No Horde source or assets are included.
